structural_test: names a specific real pattern rather than a vague aspiration
plain, short sentences with no decorative language

imagery_rules: people like me actually live here (real representation)
no fabricated product UI or tools
no clinical staging or staged pain expression
no gamification implied for sensitive subjects

cultural.second_door: Nigerian/African/diaspora context where it names a real situation more precisely
cultural.rule: a Western reader must never feel excluded; an African reader must feel deeply seen; both from the same record

faith_register.notes: Declaration faith-register is gated per product by CRF evidence + explicit brand-level approval (Section 3.10.7). Default OFF.

trust_safety: educational trust line on commercial surfaces: 'Educational content — not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice.'
crisis language only with verified real numbers
claims_boundaries: never claim more than Product Truth supports
hedge absence claims per scan coverage
